public.text: “Aspects of AI” and “reusable shared components in their own right” are vague. AI might be represented as models, evaluation infrastructure, knowledge services, model registries, secure computing, or shared interfaces.
public.suggestedRevision: Identify the possible reusable capabilities without proposing a single national AI platform.
